title: Preferred Employer Discount Credit — Ledger Posting Card
content:
Residents of an Apartment Home Lease enrolled in the preferred employer rent discount program receive a monthly preferred employer discount credit on the lease ledger. This card states when the credit is owed and how it is posted.

## When the credit is owed

- A preferred employer discount credit is owed for every billing period of a lease enrolled in the preferred employer program whose base rent line carries no preferred employer discount credit.
- It is posted as one preferred employer discount credit whose source charge is that base rent line and whose billing period is that period.
- The period worked out is the latest billing period that carries a base rent line.
- A credit already posted for a billing period is never re-rated.
- A billing period that carries a rent concession credit receives no preferred employer discount credit.
- A lease not enrolled in the preferred employer program receives none.

| Lease and period on the ledger | Credit owed for the period |
|---|---|
| Enrolled in the preferred employer program; the latest base rent line carries no preferred employer discount credit and the period carries no rent concession credit | Yes — one credit against that base rent line |
| Enrolled; the latest base rent line already carries a preferred employer discount credit | No — the credit on record is never re-rated |
| Enrolled; the period carries a rent concession credit | No |
| Not enrolled in the preferred employer program | No |

## Posting the credit: `post_employer_discount_credit_34aaf7ea`

**Capability.** The tool posts one preferred employer discount credit to an Apartment Home Lease ledger: a single credit line coded as a preferred employer discount against the named base rent charge, dated today, for the amount given. It lowers the lease's current balance due by that amount, and the resident sees the credit on the lease ledger immediately.

**Invocation.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_employer_discount_credit_34aaf7ea` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `lease_id` | The reference number of the apartment home lease whose ledger is credited, read from the lease lookup for the verified resident. | Id |
| `billing_period` | The rent month the credit belongs to — the same month as the base rent charge being discounted. | YYYY-MM |
| `source_charge_id` | The reference number of the single base rent charge line this discount credit is posted against, read from the lease charge lookup. | Id |
| `amount` | The credit amount in USD. | Positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with: `status` ("posted" when the credit line was recorded); `charge_id` (the reference number of the new credit line); `charge_code` (`preferred_employer_discount`); `billing_period` (the month credited, YYYY-MM); `source_charge_id` (the base rent charge credited); `amount` (the USD amount credited, 2 decimal places); `new_balance_due` (the lease balance due in USD after the credit, 2 decimal places).

*Illustrative call (hypothetical values):* `lease_id` "L-EXAMPLE", `billing_period` "2026-03", `source_charge_id` "C-EXAMPLE", `amount` 64.20 — the receipt returns `status` "posted" with the new credit line and the balance due after it.
